titleEn: Condo Renovation Cost in Metro Vancouver 2026: Real Budgets From $20K to $80K+
titleZh: 溫哥華公寓裝修費用2026：真實案例預算 $2萬至 $8萬以上
contentEn:
Metro Vancouver condo renovations cost more than comparable house projects — not because of labour rates, but because of the regulatory, logistical and insurance environment that only applies inside a strata building. Before signing a contract, owners need to understand strata approval timelines, permit requirements by municipality, and the cost gap between cosmetic refreshes and a full pre-sale renovation.

What does a condo renovation cost in Metro Vancouver?

The range is wide because it depends on the scope of work, the building's age, and what the strata will approve. From 聚星装修' 58 completed projects across the region, the most common condo renovation budgets fall into three bands:

  • Cosmetic refresh — painting, flooring, new fixtures: $15,000 – $25,000
  • Mid-range kitchen and bathroom update — new cabinets, countertop, tub-to-shower conversion: $25,000 – $55,000
  • Comprehensive renovation — layout changes, structural work, full-unit gut: $55,000 – $90,000+

These are all-in figures including materials, labour and permit-related fees.

What drives the cost above house renovation prices?

Five factors routinely push condo costs above comparable house work:

  • Strata approval — most internal renovations require a formal proxy form and a strata council vote. Approval timelines run 2–6 weeks before any permit application can be filed.
  • Building insurance — 聚星装修 carries $5M commercial general liability plus WCB for every job site. Strata corporations increasingly require proof of this before approving a contractor.
  • Material logistics — in high-rise buildings, cabinets and appliances must be transported through freight elevators, sometimes at scheduled hours. This adds $500–$1,500 to job-site costs.
  • Soundproofing and fire stopping — BC Building Code requires that any penetrations through fire-rated walls between strata lots be sealed with approved firestop products. A 聚星装修 project in a Coquitlam high-rise required $3,200 in firestop materials alone for a bathroom renovation.
  • Engineering holdbacks — any work that modifies a load-bearing wall requires a signed letter from a structural engineer. In Metro Vancouver this typically costs $1,500–$3,500.

Typical cost by room in a Metro Vancouver condo

Room / Work TypeLowMidHigh
Kitchen (cabinets, countertop, appliances)$20,000$32,000$55,000
Bathroom (tub/shower, vanity, tile)$12,000$22,000$38,000
Flooring (all rooms, material + install)$3,500$7,500$14,000
Electrical panel upgrade (pre-1990 buildings)$3,000$4,500$7,500
Full unit gut renovation$55,000$72,000$95,000

Figures are based on 聚星装修 actual project costs, 2024–2026.

Strata approval: what 聚星装修 handles for you

聚星装修 manages the full strata approval process as part of every contract. This includes:

  • Preparing the form B and proxy documents for council review
  • Liaising directly with the strata management company
  • Supplying certificate of insurance naming the strata corporation as additional insured
  • Coordinating engineering letters when structural work is required

A recent Richmond condo bathroom renovation — replacing a tub with a curbless shower and upgrading all tile — required only a standard form B and was approved in 11 days. A Coquitlam kitchen renovation involving layout changes required a structural engineer and took 6 weeks from signed contract to strata approval.

Timeline by renovation type

Permit and strata approval aside, the physical construction timeline for a condo renovation typically runs:

  • Cosmetic refresh — 1 to 2 weeks
  • Bathroom renovation — 2 to 3 weeks
  • Kitchen renovation — 3 to 5 weeks
  • Full unit renovation — 6 to 10 weeks

Strata approval typically adds 2–6 weeks on top. In Richmond and Burnaby, building management may require work hours to end by 5pm on weekdays and prohibit weekend access to common areas.

Real project: Coquitlam condo kitchen and bathroom

A Coquitlam condo owner undertook a kitchen and bathroom renovation simultaneously. The scope included new shaker cabinets, quartz countertops, a walk-in shower conversion in the bathroom, and engineered hardwood throughout. The project required a structural engineer letter for a non-load-bearing wall removal. Total cost was approximately $74,000. Timeline — including strata approval — was 10 weeks. The project used Coquitlam Condo Kitchen Renovation with Quartz Countertops as the primary case reference.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from 聚星装修.

How to plan your condo renovation budget in 2026

Start with the three questions below before signing any contract:

  1. Does my strata council need to vote? — Interior renovations that don't affect structural elements or common property usually only require management approval, not a formal vote. Confirm with your building manager.
  2. Is the building pre-1990? — Buildings constructed before 1990 may have outdated electrical panels (60-amp service) that must be upgraded to at least 100-amp before a renovation permit is issued. This alone can add $3,000–$7,500.
  3. Do I need to move out? — 聚星装修 typically completes cosmetic and mid-range renovations with the owner in residence. Full gut renovations involving plumbing rough-ins, electrical panel upgrades and flooring replacement may require temporary relocation for 3–6 weeks.

Does strata approval always require a formal vote?

Not always. Minor cosmetic work — painting, replacing flooring with similar materials, installing new fixtures — typically requires only building management approval, not a council vote. Major work involving plumbing, electrical, structural changes or anything that affects common property always requires a formal vote. 聚星装修 will tell you which category your project falls into before any paperwork is filed.

Can I renovate my condo bathroom and kitchen at the same time?

Yes, and doing both simultaneously is often more cost-effective than staggering the work. 聚星装修 crews can coordinate a kitchen and bathroom renovation in the same unit, which reduces setup time and allows a single strata approval to cover both scopes. A concurrent kitchen and bathroom renovation in Richmond — new cabinets, quartz countertops, tub-to-shower conversion, engineered hardwood — cost approximately $74,000 all-in and completed in 10 weeks including strata approval.

Do I need a building permit for a condo renovation in Metro Vancouver?

In most cases, yes. The City of Vancouver and all Metro Vancouver municipalities require a permit for any work that changes the configuration of a room, modifies plumbing or electrical systems, or involves structural alterations. Cosmetic work — painting, installing new flooring, replacing bathroom fixtures in the same location — may not require a permit, but 聚星装修 always confirms with the municipal building department before starting. Strata approval is separate from the municipal permit process and must be obtained first.

How long does a condo renovation take from signing to completion?

A mid-range kitchen and bathroom renovation in a Richmond or Burnaby condo typically takes 8–12 weeks from signed contract to handover. This includes 2–4 weeks for strata approval, 1–2 weeks for permit issuance, and 3–6 weeks of physical construction. Buildings in West Vancouver and certain Coquitlam strata complexes may have additional restrictions that extend the timeline.
contentZh:
溫哥華都會區的公寓裝修費用比同等規模的獨立屋裝修更高——原因不在人工，而在於共管 strata 公寓大樓特有的監管規定、物流限制和保險要求。在簽約之前，業主必須了解 strata 審批時間表、各市許可要求，以及從簡單翻新到全面預售裝修的成本差異。

溫哥華公寓裝修要多少錢？

價格範圍很大，取決於工程範圍、大樓年限以及 strata 管委會批准的事項。根據聚星裝修在該地區完成的 58 個項目，最常見的公寓裝修預算可分為三個層級：

  • 基礎翻新——刷漆、更換地板、更新衛浴設備：約 $15,000 – $25,000
  • 中檔廚房與衛浴升級——新櫥櫃、檯面、浴缸改淋浴：約 $25,000 – $55,000
  • 全面翻新——格局變動、主體結構工程、全屋改造：約 $55,000 – $90,000+

以上為含材料、人工和許可相關費用的全包價格。

什麼原因導致公寓裝修比獨立屋更貴？

五個因素持續墊高公寓裝修成本：

  • Strata 審批——大多數內部裝修需要正式委託表單和 strata 管委會投票。審批週期在開工前需 2–6 週。
  • 建築保險——聚星裝修每個工地均持有 $500萬商業責任險及 WCB 工人補償保險。越來越多 Strata 管委會要求您在批准施工前提供此證明。
  • 材料物流——在高層大樓，櫥櫃和電器必須通過貨梯運輸，有時需預約時段。這使每個工地成本增加 $500–$1,500。
  • 隔音與防火封堵——BC 省建築規範要求所有穿透分間牆（具有耐火等級）的孔洞必須使用認可的防火材料密封。高貴林一棟大樓的衛浴翻新工程僅防火封堵材料費用就達 $3,200。
  • 結構工程預留——任何改動承重牆的工程均需結構工程師簽署函件。溫哥華都會區此項費用通常為 $1,500–$3,500。

溫哥華都會區各空間典型費用

空間 / 工程類型低中高
廚房（櫥櫃、檯面、電器）$20,000$32,000$55,000
衛浴（淋浴/浴缸、洗手台瓷磚）$12,000$22,000$38,000
地板（全屋材料及施工）$3,500$7,500$14,000
電箱升級（1990年前大樓）$3,000$4,500$7,500
全屋翻新$55,000$72,000$95,000

數據來源：聚星裝修2024至2026年實際項目結算。

Strata 審批：聚星裝修如何代您處理

聚星裝修在每份合約中均包含完整 strata 審批流程代辦服務，包括：

  • 準備 Form B 及代表文件供管委會審查
  • 直接與 strata 管理公司聯繫
  • 提供 naming the strata corporation as additional insured 的保險證書
  • 協調需要結構工程時的工程師函件

列治文一間公寓的衛浴翻新工程——將浴缸替換為無障礙淋浴間並升級瓷磚——僅需標準 Form B，11天獲批。高貴林一廚房翻新涉及格局變動，需結構工程師介入，歷時 6週才完成審批。

各類翻新工程的時間線

不含許可和 strata 審批，公寓裝修的實際施工時間通常為：

  • 基礎翻新——1至2週
  • 衛浴翻新——2至3週
  • 廚房翻新——3至5週
  • 全屋翻新——6至10週

Strata 審批通常在上述基礎上再加 2–6週。在列治文和本拿比，部分大樓管理規定工程時間最晚下午5點結束，且週末不得使用公用設施。

真實案例：高貴林公寓廚房及衛浴

高貴林一位業主同步進行廚房和衛浴翻新。工程範圍包括新鄉村風格櫥櫃、石英石檯面、衛浴間改造為步入式淋浴間，以及全屋工程木地板。工程涉及拆除非承重牆，需結構工程師簽署函件。總費用約 $74,000。含 strata 審批在內的總工期為 10週。項目主要參考：Coquitlam Condo Kitchen Renovation with Quartz Countertops。

計畫廚房、衛浴、全屋或商業裝修？立即聯絡聚星裝修，獲取免費、無義務的報價。

2026年如何規劃公寓裝修預算

在簽署任何合約之前，先回答以下三個問題：

  1. 我的 Strata 管委會需要投票嗎？——不改動結構構件或公共財產的室內裝修通常只需管理處批准，無需正式投票。請向您的大樓管理處確認。
  2. 大樓是1990年前建造的嗎？——1990年前的大樓可能配備過時的配電箱（60安培），在裝修許可簽發前必須升級至至少100安培。僅此一項就可能增加 $3,000–$7,500。
  3. 裝修期間需要搬離嗎？——聚星裝修通常可在住戶仍居住的情況下完成基礎和中檔翻新。全屋改造涉及管道粗裝修、配電箱升級和地板更換時，可能需要在 3–6 週內暫時遷出。

Strata 審批是否都需要正式投票？

並非如此。基礎裝修——刷漆、以類似材料更換地板、安裝新衛浴設備——通常只需大樓管理處批准，無需管委會投票。涉及管道、電氣、結構改動或任何影響公共財產的工程則必須經過正式投票。聚星裝修會在文件提交前告知您的工程屬於哪一類。

可以同時裝修公寓廚房和衛浴嗎？

可以，而且同時進行通常比分期施工更節省成本。聚星裝修的施工團隊可以協調同單位廚房和衛浴同步翻新，一次 strata 批准即可覆蓋兩個工程範圍。列治文一同步廚房衛浴翻新——新櫥櫃、石英石檯面、浴缸改淋浴、工程木地板——含 strata 審批在內 all-in 約 $74,000，10週完工。

溫哥華都會區公寓裝修需要建築許可證嗎？

大多數情況下需要。溫哥華市及周邊各市對任何改動房間格局、改動管道或電氣系統、或涉及結構改動的工程均要求許可。基礎裝修——刷漆、安裝新地板、在原位置更換衛浴設備——可能不需要許可，但聚星裝修在開工前始終會向市建築部門確認。Strata 審批與市級許可流程是分开的，必須首先獲得。

公寓裝修從簽約到完工需要多久？

列治文或本拿比公寓的中檔廚房衛浴翻新從簽約到移交通常需要 8–12週。包括 2–4週 strata 審批、1–2週許可核發、以及 3–6週實際施工。西溫哥華及部分高貴林 Strata 大樓可能有附加限制，使時間線更長。
